rationale: Close the paused TimeoutNow Candidate locally at the total execution-window boundary; the missing delayed-delivery experiment cannot be completed and reviewed within the remaining controller time.
resume_conditions: Resume when a controlled transport can hold a TimeoutNow from an old leader and release it after a new leader is established.
Retain the recipient follower's state transition, campaign term, and the new leader's authority observation before treating any disruption as a confirmed defect.
